q-25403.worked_solution:

q-61447.name: Question 2
q-61447.worked_solution:
We substitute $x=-2$ and then evaluate the absolute values before we simplify the rest of the expression:

$$
\begin{aligned}|x+3|-|3x-1|+x & = \\ |-2+3|-|3(-2)-1|+(-2) & = \\ |1|-|-6-1|-2 & = \\ |1|-|-7|-2 & = \\ 1-7-2 & = \\ -8 & \end{aligned}
$$

a
5
b
6
c
−9
d

Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

We substitute x=−2 and then evaluate the absolute values before we simplify the rest of the expression: |x+3|−|3x−1|+x=|−2+3|−|3(−2)−1|+(−2)=|1|−|−6−1|−2=|1|−|−7|−2=1−7−2=−8

q-103235.name: Question 3
q-103235.worked_solution:
We substitute $x=-5$ and then evaluate the absolute values before we simplify the rest of the expression:

$$
\begin{aligned}|{x}^{2}|-2|x|+6 & = \\ |(-5)^{2}|-2|-5|+6 & = \\ |25|-2(5)+6 & = \\ 25-10+6 & = \\ 21 & \end{aligned}
$$
